source.source_claim: The official National Assembly roster states that there are currently 290 members elected by registered votes and publishes member, county, constituency, party and status fields.

method.preparation: Fetch the official Parliament roster pages, retain only rows whose constituency reconciles one-to-one to the canonical 290-constituency registry, then freeze the checked source rows as the release snapshot.
method.canonical_mapping: Normalized constituency name plus explicit source row metadata; no county or party inference.
method.observation_value: Text category containing the published member name and party.

acceptance: Exactly 290 canonical constituencies reconcile to exactly one elected National Assembly member.
Every promoted row retains the Parliament-published member name, party, constituency and source URL.
Nominated members and county women representatives are excluded because they do not occupy a constituency MP slot.
No constituency identity is inferred from county membership or copied from a parent geography.
Duplicate, missing or ambiguous constituency matches fail the tranche.
Canonical build is deterministic from the frozen source snapshot.
Completeness improves by exactly 290 governed P23 slot instances and unknown_missing remains zero.
Full Atlas validation and P16 release audit remain green before promotion to main.

cascade_context.population_boundary_hold: The KNBS constituency population/household table located during this audit is the 2009 census table and predates the current 290-constituency boundary system. It must not be silently mapped to the 2012-01 constituency registry.
cascade_context.health_density_hold: KMHFR supports constituency/ward facility assignment, but a density requires a defensible target-level population denominator; facility counts alone must not be presented as population density.
